goals: Say what BFS is for and when a traversal helps.
Trace BFS by hand: the next vertex, the queue, the visited set and the order.

segments.title: Placeholder: when is BFS the right tool?
Placeholder: tracing BFS step by step
segments.body:
Start at A. Neighbours are taken in alphabetical order.

| Step | Visit | Queue after | Visited after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A | B, C | A, B, C |
| 2 | B | C, D | A, B, C, D |
| 3 | C | D, E | A, B, C, D, E |

Keep going until the queue is empty.

activities.title: Placeholder: when is BFS the right tool?

config.prompt: You want every building reachable from the library, nearest first. Which fits?

options.label: BFS: it visits vertices level by level

feedback.sort: Sorting orders the names but says nothing about which buildings connect.
feedback.none: Reachability depends on the paths between buildings, so a traversal is needed.

hints.body: Think about what 'nearest first' asks for.
BFS explores all vertices one edge away before any two edges away.
